page.overview:
What is 'Muff Said?

Muff Said is one of the muffin stores that opened on the same block as Edna Krabappel's muffin store, Edna's Edibles, along with R. Crumb's Keep on Muffin', H.R. Muffin Stuff and Muff Mart. The name 'Muff Said is a possible parody of/reference to Marvel Comic's famous saying: 'Nuff said.

The store only appears in Episode 2, Season 21.
